Reuses radio 7fbf2bfc9badc7d3 and the existing Dashboard 2.0 group; does not define or modify configuration nodes. Enable this disabled tab and deploy it manually after importing. The local one-second clock requests meter list at startup, retries unavailable inventory after 15 seconds, and refreshes inventory every 60 seconds. Subscriptions resolve exact source/number/name identities to numeric meter IDs, avoiding MQTT wildcard ambiguity in +13.8A and AGC+. Only meter list and sub meter <numeric ID> are sent. No RF, audio, slice, transmit or other write commands. Subscription errors and missing meters appear on cards and in Debug. Waiting for data is not treated as a failed subscription. Samples older than 15 seconds are marked stale. All values originate in the installed flexradio-js scaling; no duplicate scaling. FWDPWR and REFPWR keep the raw dBm sample and convert Watts with 10 ** ((dBm - 30) / 10). Signal meter units come from radio metadata; missing units are explicitly labelled. PASTAT is raw with no undocumented bit decoding. Gauges are display scales only, with unclipped numbers and out-of-scale labels. Browser widgets have no outbound wires or radio controls. Live subscriptions have not been tested by Codex. Deploy helper remaps node IDs while preserving the external radio and Dashboard group IDs.

label: EXPERIMENT - AU-510M Auto AGC-T Watcher
info: AU-510M AGC-T calibration: save the original threshold, start at 100, measure post-AGC and LEVEL, scan down in 10-point coarse steps and 2-point fine steps within the first knee bracket. Each point settles 300 ms and measures 700 ms with at least five samples; knee drop and LEVEL stability limits are 2 dB. Apply the configured final offset. Abort on TX, slice/frequency/mode changes, stale meters or unstable LEVEL; restore the original threshold after fresh readback when RX and the original slice are available. No tuning, TX, mode, antenna, RF-power or ATU writes.

info: Separate AU-510M watcher. Auto defaults OFF; tab exported disabled. All nine states implemented. Exact API: slice s <slice> agc_threshold=<integer 0..100>, documented by FlexRadio https://github.com/flexradio/smartsdr-api-docs/wiki/TCPIP-slice#SET and transported by installed flexradio-request / flexradio-radio / flexradio-js. Status field agc_threshold. Actual hardware success requires zero response and matching live threshold status after each command. No power/mode/antenna/transmit/tuning command permitted. Scan only at a user-configured quiet frequency, selected active slice dynamically. No invented quiet frequencies. UI /agct-watcher offers per-band quiet MHz, use-current, clear, and optional scan start; persistent settings saved atomically at /mnt/dietpi_userdata/node-red/agct-watcher-settings.json. Use-current saves only a frequency; does not retune or certify quietness. Manual tune to the configured frequency before calibration in this version. Baseline 4 seconds; downward steps of 2, settle 2.5 seconds, 4-second windows, >=20 live dBm samples of both meters. Reject >2 dB spread or >1 dB input drift. Require observed plateau, >=1.5 dB AGC+ fall and a second independent confirmation window. Knee offset +1, then one confirmed final apply and DONE. RX loss, changed slice/receive settings, stale data, failed commands or timeouts abort with no restoration/write on TX. OFF immediately revokes permits; last applied threshold remains on abort. Read requests only from subscription whitelist; write gate accepts only matching, expiring, single-use core permits. No dashboard backend changes. Live calibration not yet validated. Deploy/update explicitly: node /mnt/dietpi_userdata/node-red/scripts/deploy-agct-watcher.mjs --deploy .
